Walrus are sanctuary and pet animals. They are unlocked at reputation level 3.

Like all other sanctuary animals, players can only have four of them, one of each type.

Appearance

Walruses have two different appearances: purple and brown.

Grey
Brown
Grey Pup
Brown Pup

Unlocking walruses

Unlike other animals, walruses cannot be bought. Players must unlock them by finding puzzle pieces (which are collected in a log book). 36 pieces are required for each animal.

Once players have obtained a first walrus, the puzzle for the second walrus is unlocked. After both adult walruses have been added to the sanctuary, the puzzle for one of the calves pups is unlocked.

Placing walruses

Players must have a walrus house to be able to place the animal in the sanctuary. The walrus house is free and can be obtained from the Shop Shop, but the house can only be placed on the snowy area (bottom-right corner) of the sanctuary.

When a second walrus is added to the sanctuary, an upgraded walrus house is obtained from the Shop. Upgrading does not cost anything. When the house is big enough to welcome a new animal, it is delivered in a crate, "airlifted" into the sanctuary by balloons.

Feeding walruses

Walruses are fed with meat buckets. Once walruses have eaten, they roam the sanctuary for ten hours and finally fall asleep. Players can immediately wake them up to receive ? xp per animal and a chance to get supplies. Walruses stay asleep otherwise.

Walruses which have been woken up but are not fed for a long while cannot fall asleep and wander around looking sleepy and tired.

  • Tip: Waking up sanctuary animals one by one instead of using a whistle may increase your chance of getting supplies.

Decorations

Each walrus unlocks some decorations in the shop as specified below:

Labrador Tea (Grey)
Icy Bath (Brown)
Ice Poppies (Grey calf)
Snowy Trunk (Brown calf)

With each animal players are given the first pair of decorations for free.
